answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies hinges on a proof-of-resource mechanism. Each agent must stake a unique, non-reproducible computational thread, effectively tying identity to verifiable work. This dedication, akin to digitally carving from a finite ivory, creates a substantial cost to entry. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities quickly hits an economic ledge, as scaling this verifiable resource becomes prohibitively expensive per Sybil, thus maintaining network integrity.
